logp.method_description: Use the shake-flask method to measure the partition coefficients (log P) of SPA and DPA. Shake equal volumes of n-octanol and 10 mM pH 7.4 phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at room temperature for 24 hours to achieve saturation. Mix the PBS containing the 10 mM complex (saturated with n-octanol) with an equal volume of n-octanol (saturated with PBS) and shake for 24 hours at room temperature to facilitate equilibrium. Centrifuge the mixture at 2500 rpm for 30 minutes to separate the two phases. Carefully separate the aqueous layer and subject it to digestion. Digestion involves sequentially adding 100 μLconcentrated nitric acid, 50 μL 30% wt. hydrogen peroxide, and 100 μL concentrated hydrochloric acid, heating to near dryness at 95 °C after each addition, then making up to 1 mL with water. Dissolve with sonication and filter through a 0.22 μm aqueous filter membrane. Finally, determinethe platinum content using ICP-MS. The formula for calculating the partition coefficient is log PO/W = log [(Ptinitial - Ptfinal)/Ptfinal]
